Hi Tariq / Alyssa,

Thanks again for committing time for the Acme POC. Before we lock the official kickoff I want to run a short sandbox rehearsal that covers three focused items:

- Prompt & workload review (20m): verify representative prompts and expected output shapes.
- Routing & tiering walkthrough (25m): model selection, fallback rules, and region failover mapping.
- Load rehearsal (25m): small-scale prefix caching + KV-cache warmup + a small concurrency run to validate throughput.

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 27, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Oct 28, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Oct 29, 08:00–09:00

Please pick a preferred slot and confirm who will be on the call from Acme. I attached a short agenda and the sandbox access instructions to this note. If you need a different timezone, tell us your constraints and we’ll adapt — we want to make sure the regional endpoints you’ll test (us-west, us-east) are exercised.

Action items for Acme before the rehearsal:
- Provide a sanitized sample of 50 prompt instances (or grant access to a test S3 path).
- Confirm a single contact who can approve temporary sandbox access.

Attachments: acme-poc-agenda-v1.pdf; sandbox-access-instructions.txt
